sites.name: aShemaleTube
sites.testResult: The built-in playerConfig recipe alone resolved both test videos (1265329 and 900378) to their HLS streams, with titles from og:title. A 20-second sample downloaded with exactly its URL and options was H.264 852x480 with AAC audio, saved as "Skinny ts takes bbc [skinny-ts-takes-bbc].mp4"; every frame decoded cleanly. Earlier: the full 118 MB video (18:58) decoded, and a Cloudflare 403 fell back to the browser fetch and resolved in 8.6 s.
sites.notes: yt-dlp has no extractor for this site. The page is behind a Cloudflare bot check that answers about a third of plain requests with HTTP 403 whatever their headers; yt-dlp itself gets 403 unless it impersonates a browser. The recipe fetches plainly and, on a 403 or challenge page, falls back to fetching through yt-dlp as desktop Chrome (Safari fingerprints never pass). The video is in the player config as sources.hlsAuto, an HLS master playlist (480p and 240p) on cdn.ashemaletube.com that needs no referer or cookies; the generic extractor can't read it because it's in a script, not markup, so the built-in playerConfig recipe (unescape the page, take the first stream or video URL under a common player key) finds it with no site-specific settings; the title comes from the page's og:title. This replaced a Python plugin, archived in sites/plugins-archive.

sites.name: Fuq / PornHD / GotPorn
sites.testResult: Followed one /out/ link from each site. Fuq and GotPorn went to xHamster; yt-dlp's XHamster extractor downloaded 20-second 1080p samples (H.264 1920x1080, AAC), and every frame decoded cleanly. PornHD's first link went to Lustery, a paid site, where only a 0.6-second 360p preview is public.
sites.notes: These three sites share one aggregator template and host no videos themselves. Each video card is an /out/?l=... link that redirects (HTTP) to the hosting site, mostly xHamster and eporner, and yt-dlp follows the redirect to that site's extractor, so the aggregator link can be given to Siphon as is, with no options. What downloads depends on the destination: links to paid sites such as Lustery lead to a public preview, and members' videos are not fetched.
